This year my theme is bridal looks and this is dedicated to all my brides and bridesmaids who send me hundreds of dms to create looks💕

Also this for a part of me who thought is going to be a 2026 bride. Who needs a groom to create some surreal wedding moodboard anyway? 

 From this series, you can take my recommendations for literally everything wedding. 
From designers to makeup artists. Jewellery to even event planner. 💕✨

Hope upu huys are hoing to love this series as much as I loved making it✨

Happy Navrathri bangarams🥰
